note: §S2-INTERVENING — the FIRST HONEST READING of C70 K-INV-2 (2026-08-14), pinned so it may only fall. Every row is ONE MERGE PATH that this gate DROVE and watched discard a peer's authored value WITHOUT emitting a CRDTConflict. They share ONE root cause, so they will fall together: YjsDocAdapter._discloseOverwrittenLocalWrites ends with `this._localPendingWrites.delete(docKey)`, clearing the WHOLE doc's pending bookkeeping after ANY merge - including edits still in flight that have not yet met their rival. The rows are enumerated ONE PER DISPOSITION rather than collapsed to a single root-cause row on purpose: a single row would let 102 of these become permanently invisible if a partial fix landed, and the ledger is checked in BOTH directions - a path that starts disclosing must LEAVE this file in the commit that fixes it, or the gate exits 3 STALE (C70 5.4). S1-DIRECT (103/103 disclosed) and S3-AGREEING (0 discards) are CLEAN and are deliberately NOT in this file.
rootCause: packages/sync-client/src/YjsDocAdapter.ts - _discloseOverwrittenLocalWrites: `this._localPendingWrites.delete(docKey)` at the end of the pass discards disclosure eligibility for in-flight local writes that the merge did not touch.
